finding: Convoy arrival could classify sideways/vertical motion or rotation as stationary because it checked only forward speed before its five-second settlement window.
implementation: Require finite total linear velocity below1km/h and angular velocity below0.01rad/s for every vehicle during the existing continuous settlement window. Existing route and spacing conditions retained.
scope: Arrival classification only; catch-up, compression, contact and safety gains unchanged.
cost: At most20 vehicles use fixed vector reads/magnitudes at existing tick; no new worker or discovery. Actual overhead unmeasured.
remaining: Mixed tracked/wheeled stop/start and native movement remain physically unverified
Angular threshold calibration requires engine evidence
Existing spatial criteria do not establish full path/formation coherence
